_comment: The benchmark suite's configuration, version-controlled so a result can be
traced to the exact parameters that produced it. scripts/run_benchmarks.py
reads this file; changing a number here changes what gets published, and
the diff shows up in review rather than hiding in someone's shell history.
record_counts are chosen so each scenario runs for a few seconds: long
enough that start-up effects are amortised, short enough that the whole
suite finishes in minutes. The 'quick' value is for sanity runs only and
must never be used for published numbers -- too short to be stable.
brokers        broker processes to start (>1 starts a real cluster)
replication    replication factor for the topic
durable        run brokers with a tight flush interval, so an acks=quorum
result measures the engine rather than the flush timer
broker_flags   extra broker flags; used where the flag changes what a
measurement *means* (fsync mode) rather than tuning it
driver         which pulselog-bench scenario to run

scenarios.name: 01-single-producer-no-replication
scenarios.description: One producer, one broker, one partition, no replication

scenarios.name: 02-multi-producer-one-partition
scenarios.description: Four producers contending on a single partition

scenarios.name: 04-concurrent-producers-consumers
scenarios.description: Producers and consumers running at the same time

scenarios.name: 06-quorum-ack
scenarios.description: acks=quorum: a majority must have persisted the record

scenarios.name: 07-replication-under-load
scenarios.description: Three brokers, replication factor 3, sustained produce

scenarios.name: 08-no-batching
scenarios.description: Batch size 1: the cost the batching path is measured against

scenarios.name: 10-large-message
scenarios.description: 64 KiB values, where the disk and the socket dominate

scenarios.name: 11-acks-none
scenarios.description: acks=none: no durability guarantee, the throughput ceiling

scenarios.name: 12-fsync-full-vs-data
scenarios.description: acks=leader with fsync mode 'data' rather than 'full'

scenarios.name: 13-baseline-mutex-queue
scenarios.description: In-process mutex-protected queue: no network, no protocol, no disk
